name: comfyui-imagegen
description: Generate local images through ComfyUI workflows from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run local ComfyUI workflows from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Submits API-format workflows to a local ComfyUI server, uploads reference images, waits for completion, and saves generated images locally.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image with my local ComfyUI workflow.
